distribution: Linux binary linked against system libraries; not a universal portable or static binary

tools: C headers and libc development files

runtime.platform: Linux with pidfd support (kernel 5.3+), matching ELF loader and library ABIs
runtime.compositor: Hyprland with the required IPC and Wayland protocols; see docs/compatibility.md
system_libraries: D-Bus and other transitive system dependencies
runtime.native_keyboard_keymaps: Self-contained maps require libxkbcommon, but not xkeyboard-config data files or /usr/share/X11/xkb; external helpers may have their own requirements

helpers.required_for: XWayland keyboard and scroll; matching X11 DISPLAY and XWayland server
explicit helper keyboard backend on Wayland
AT-SPI in managed sessions; accessible application widgets also required

optional_components_not_bundled.session_preview: zig build pip: deskctl-pip beside deskctl; GTK4 >= 4.8 development/runtime libraries, grim; host Hyprlang/Lua window rules (tested on Hyprland 0.56.2). Not included in the default CLI archive
optional_components_not_bundled.headless_bridge: Local C++23 build against Aquamarine 0.15.0, pixman and libdrm; restricted Hyprland 0.56.2 stack; parent Wayland renderer required
optional_components_not_bundled.cursor_outline: Local C++23 build with exact Hyprland 0.56.2 headers and matching ABI; OpenGL and Hyprlang activation only
optional_components_not_bundled.live_test_fixtures: Python GI, GTK4 and AT-SPI; opt-in, never run by packaging or CI
optional_components_not_bundled.blender_example: Blender with the original deskctl room open; not bundled or executed by packaging
